theirReference: It was my first time in Colombia and of course I needed a good hand to trust. It was Cristian. My flight was delayed and I arrived so late at the airport… Even he was sleepy, welcomed me… He is a super kind person and defined knows the soul of travelers… His mother, If you have a chance to meet her, a wonderful women with full of life and energy… The smart brother is also so kind and helpful. And there are Pancho and three cats; somehow you meet them… I appreciate the privacy they supplied for me and safe feelings…. The architecture of the house is like a puzzle but so convenient to live. The view from their terrace is Bogotá!
myReference: Artnur stayed at my place for a couple of days and it was a great experience hosting him. He is a very warm and kind person, always polite and respectful. He brought me some delicious cookies from Turkey and a beautiful fridge magnet from Istanbul, which was such a thoughtful gesture. He kept everything very clean and followed the house rules perfectly. I truly appreciated his company and would happily host him again. Highly recommended!

theirReference: Wow, Christian was my first experience from this app, and he set a very high standard. He regularly hosts travelers at his house and has a tidy place for everyone with a shower, wifi kitchen and everything you needs… He and his family were extremely nice and took care of everything I needed. And even joined me for meals. Christian also gave me a tour of the city and made me know things I did not know about. and shared a lot of his knowledge of the country with me. Good people with pure intentions, who made me a soft landing in Colombia. In short, do yourself a favor and meet him.
myReference: Orel was a wonderful guest, very kind and genuinely interested in learning about the local culture. He was very clean, respectful, and always showed a great attitude. Communication with him was excellent, and he followed all the house rules. 🤩 We went for walks around El Chorro de Quevedo, where he also tried cholao. Orel is a very open-minded, intelligent, and interesting person, and his Spanish is very good. He also let me try Turkish coffee, which was absolutely delicious. 😁 I truly appreciate the thoughtful gifts he gave me — a handmade bracelet and a lucky magnet. 😇 Hosting him was definitely a great experience, and I would happily recommend him to any future host. 💫⭐️✨

theirReference: Really great experience, welcoming family, would stay again. A few pets that were well behaved and a really fun way to integrate with local life.
myReference: Waleed was an excellent guest. He is a very kind and respectful person with a genuine interest in learning about the local culture, which made the experience very enjoyable. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ It was a very fun experience full of positive energy. He is easygoing and always brings great vibes, which made sharing time together a pleasure. He is also a very interesting person; he told me about his literary projects and shared insights about life in the UAE, which led to some fascinating conversations. 🤗 He even prepared dinner for my family and me, cooking a traditional Japanese dish. It was honestly the best teriyaki chicken I have ever had, and I truly appreciate the time, effort, and kindness behind that gesture. ✨ Throughout his stay, he had great communication, a positive attitude, and followed all the house rules without any issues. It was definitely a great experience hosting him, and I highly recommend him as a guest. 💯 خذ بالك من نفسك، وإن شاء الله نشوفك قريب! 🇦🇪😄
